decisions.reason: Both questions restate the label's qualifiers ('across the whole country', 'news outlets', 'across the nation', 'publicity') so they hint 'nationwide media coverage'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Ask without the qualifiers, e.g. 'What did the Green Suit Rebellion receive?' with the declaration as the source, or drop this near-duplicate target of acq-006-03.

decisions.reason: Questions restate 'nation'/'news'/'press across the country', hinting 'national media attention'.
decisions.suggested_fix: E.g. 'What did the Green Suit Rebellion attract?' or drop the near-duplicate target.

decisions.reason: Q1 contains 'commitment', part of the label 'Environmental commitment', and asks for the object of the commitment; Q2 ('What idea did the green suits signal') still cannot be told from acq-006-13.
decisions.suggested_fix: Ask 'In the Ludlow Springs protest, green suits were a symbol of what quality shown by protesters toward the environment?' or merge groups 09 and 11.
